result:
The proposed answer of 1 is most likely wrong. The argument is hand-wavy at the key step. It asserts that the non-split locus is a Noether–Lefschetz hypersurface without showing why it is cut out by the same single condition as the nodal locus. The nodal Coble surfaces are a distinguished special locus, and a non-nodal family with the same boundary behaviour would plausibly be more special, giving codimension 2. I recall that the published result on Pompilj automorphisms of Coble surfaces describes this second family as having codimension 2, but I cannot verify that from memory, so my confidence is moderate.

VERDICT: REJECT

CONFIDENCE: 2
